method: MIDASim dependent masks with conditional ICFM on masked CLR positive abundances
zero_handling: Exact dependent presence masks from the matched full MIDASim role draws; conditional masked-CLR ICFM abundances and softmax over present taxa only. No pseudocount, threshold tuning or sequencing-count fabrication.
mask_pairing: The seven MIDASim role masks are reused exactly; zero fraction, richness and prevalence match MIDASim by construction, not as independent fidelity evidence.
generator_selection: Fixed 1024-wide four-block conditional velocity and 8000-epoch budget; original10443 training rows only, no generator selection on assessment data
